text:
ashwin: noticed invoice-preview drift after route-priority v2 canary. some tenants show token surplus. anyone digging?

maria: alert on preview pipeline, ~1.5% shortfall concentrated on long sessions.

kevin: we added a small tombstone event when sessions get reassigned: type=route_swap, delta_tokens negative. proxy filters were dropping non-usage types under high load.

sophie: that means we never subtract from the old tenant. downstream tally only sees the + on new tenant.

ashwin: sample tombstone string: {type:route_swap, session:sess-9, from:teamA, to:teamB, delta:-300}

mike: options: (1) producer emits negative usage records; (2) tally consumer accepts route_swap and applies delta; (3) run a replay to fix past window.

maria: (2) is correct semantically but touches hotpath. we should gate it and canary.

kevin: I'll schedule a replay from ingress buffer for 10m window around canary and mark it reingest_reason=route_swap_miss.

sophie: I'll add an e2e in console preview to synthesize route_swap + usage and assert preview == ledger after reconciliation.

mike: I'll add dashboard panels: preview_vs_ledger_delta, consumer_p99, tombstone_forward_rate. also prepare rollout runbook.

ingest-bot: Alert: invoice_preview_delta > 0.5% for enterprise tenants at 2026-03-21T11:02Z.

ashwin: owners: kevin=replay+producer patch, maria=consumer change, sophie=tests, mike=dashboards. implement consumer change behind feature flag enable_route_swap_handling and canary to 5% -> 25%.

maria: keep route_swap mapping to existing aggregation path and use session_id+event_id dedupe to avoid double-apply.

ashwin: ok. small status updates here. escalate if >1% sustained delta or consumer p99 regresses.
